label: Fig1_TAL_IV
comments: Peripheral venous blood (7.5 ml) was sampled into plastic tubes (S-Monovetten, Sarstedt AG, Nu ̈mbrecht, Germany) just before and at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 60, 80, 100 min, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, and 24 h after administration to measure talinolol serum concentrations. Urine was collected between 0 and 48 h to determine the parameters of renal drug elimination.
